title: Completion of the Shahnameh
summary: Abolqasem Ferdowsi finished the Shahnameh, the Persian Book of Kings, in 1010 after beginning it in 977. Reference accounts say he came from the city of Tus. The poem of about 50,000 rhymed couplets narrates the history of ancient Persia from the creation of the world to the Arab conquest of 651, which ended the Sassanian Empire.

uncertainty.note: Start is the year Ferdowsi began the work (977); end is its completion (1010), given as 8 March 1010 by World History Encyclopedia. Cambridge gives 1010 AD.
